name: Generate creative lists for visual arts and designs
description: Users asked the AI to generate lists of creative ideas, design concepts, or thematic combinations for various visual media, predominantly focusing on toddler coloring book prompts, tattoo designs, and contemporary art paintings. While the neighboring group focused on technical prompts for image generation software, these requests emphasized broader ideation and content curation for distinct artistic or commercial products.
